title: Lower memory use for large backups
summary: Large backups use less memory, linked folders can rebuild missing local copies, and desktop recovery stays in sync if a save is interrupted.
details: Read and write backup media in small chunks. Verify file integrity on import and clean up partial files when an import fails or is cancelled.
Keep the desktop and its recovery snapshots in sync when switching setups, removing widgets or restoring them.
Rebuild missing local copies from linked folders and keep the current slideshow usable if a refresh cannot finish.
Verify the publisher’s signature before installing an update and keep the previous copy available until the updated app finishes starting.
Open the Arras website from the globe in the Photos footer and find the developer credit in Privacy.
